To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the herpes family of viruses, in particular the Herpes Simplex virus type 2 and Herpes Virus type 1, are the key instigators of hypertension.
the Neuroinvasive viral infections of the heart are a major cause of the hypertension and other cardiovascular diseases.
the hypertension and other cardiovascular dysfunctions are driven by the Neuro-invasive viruses that cause the anatomical and electrical dysfunction in the myocardium cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the herpes virus in the pathogenesis of hypertension and other cardiac disorders.
the role of the herpes family of viruses in the cardiovascular system and their role in hypertension, atherosclerosis and other cardiovascular diseases.
the understanding of the role of the herpes family of viruses in the pathogenesis of the cardiovascular disease.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hypertension is a complex and multifactorial disease.
the hypertension and its related cardiac dysfunctions are caused due to the viral infections.
the primary & secondary hypertension is the result of Neuroinvasive viral induced pathological issues.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hypertension can be eradicated by the medical intervention of the Neuroinvasive viral infection and the associated anatomical and physiological dysfunction.
, the hypertension is the outcome of the Neuroinvasive viral infection.
the hypertension is not a disease in itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the viral induced hypertension is not a primary hypertension.
the hypertension is a consequence of the Neuroinvasive viral infections.
we are not only able to identify the cause of hypertension but also able to treat it.
